what_to_detect: A spell cast for its overload cost resolves with no target and affects every object its text, with 'target' read as 'each', describes.
near_miss: The same spell cast for its mana cost resolves on its one target.
record_fields: gen-3 card lines[].cast_with on the stack object (the alternative-cost line it was cast with)
payload events, one per affected object

what_to_detect: A candidate casting a spell for its overload cost is playable although no object is a legal target for its targeted text.
near_miss: The same spell's mana-cost casting with no legal target, not playable.
record_fields: which line (mana cost or the Overload keyword line) the candidate casts with
